subject: KV-cache chain-of-custody & witness run instructions (SOC 2 / SIG evidence)
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@harborfinance.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Harbor Finance Security Team <security@harborfinance.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Request: KV cache timestamps & warmstart witness for SOC 2 audit

Marcus / Redwood team —

Thanks again for the call this morning. As part of our SOC 2 evidence package and SIG assessment, the auditors have asked for a tight chain-of-custody on any KV cache warmstart artifacts that underpin our RTO/RPO claims. Specifically they want: 

- A timestamped export of KV cache snapshots used during the most recent warmstart (including UTC timestamps and node identifiers)
- An operations witness checklist with who executed the run, commands used, and any fallback steps taken
- Raw warmstart trace (logs) covering the start -> serve-ready window for the run on 2026-11-24

Can you confirm you can provide these items and whether you can host a short live witness (30–45m) for our auditors next week? We are working toward a submission deadline of 2026-12-01. 

Thanks — Elena
Elena Soto
Senior InfoSec Manager, Harbor Finance
elena.soto@harborfinance.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@harborfinance.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: KV cache timestamps & warmstart witness for SOC 2 audit

Elena —

We can provide everything you listed. Quick summary of what we'll deliver and the timing: 

- kv-cache-timestamps.csv: per-shard snapshot timestamps and node IDs for the 2026-11-24 warmstart run (UTC).
- warmstart-trace-20261124.log: compressed trace of the service start through first serve-ready token. Sensitive fields redacted.
- ops-witness-checklist.pdf: one-page checklist we use for witness runs with sign-off block for auditor.

We can host a live witness session on 2026-11-30 or 2026-12-01; recommend 30 minutes (demo of artifacts + Q&A). Which day/time works for your team?

Operational notes / controls we will call out during the witness: 
- All artifacts are exported from the immutable run bucket (s3://redwood-warmstart-exports/prod/2026-11-24/) and immutable audit hashes are included in the CSV.
- Exports are generated by the oncall runbook step and signed with our key stored in KMS; we will show the KMS audit entry during the witness.
- If auditors want, we can perform a short replay of the warmstart in a non-prod slice that reproduces the timelines (same sequence lengths & config).

I'll ask Ops to stage the files and we will upload the CSV + logs to a Drive folder and share a DocuSign witness acknowledgement so the auditors can sign-off electronically during/after the session.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: KV-cache chain-of-custody & witness run instructions (SOC 2 / SIG evidence)

Marcus / Vanessa —

Quick ops plan to produce artifacts: 

1) Runbook execution (2026-11-24 warmstart) — already completed by ops-run-3. We captured: start_ts, node_id, snapshot_hash, export_path.
2) Export generation — produce kv-cache-timestamps.csv with fields: utc_ts,node_id,shard_id,snapshot_hash,export_path,audit_hash.
3) Upload to immutable exports bucket + copy to Drive link shared with Harbor.
4) Produce warmstart-trace-20261124.log (redact IPs).
5) Create ops-witness-checklist.pdf and pre-fill with: operator name (R. Chen), run ID (ops-run-3), duration (00:02:48), anomalies (none).

Attachments: ops-witness-checklist.pdf (stub), kv-cache-timestamps.csv (stub), warmstart-trace-20261124.log (stub).

Vanessa: please confirm that KMS audit entries for the export key are included in the Drive folder (we need both the KMS entry id and the time range). Also mark the Drive folder with read-only link for Harbor security.

On scheduling: Harbor asked for 30–45m next week. My preference: 2026-11-30 10:00–10:45 PST. If that works I will assign R. Chen + SRE oncall and prepare the short replay in a non-prod slice for demo.

Grace
Senior Manager, Site Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@harborfinance.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Harbor Finance Security Team <security@harborfinance.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: KV-cache chain-of-custody & witness run instructions (SOC 2 / SIG evidence)

Marcus / Grace / Vanessa —

Thanks, that looks good. We confirm 2026-11-30 10:00–10:45 PST for the witness session. Please share the Drive link and a calendar invite with a brief agenda.

Two small asks for the evidence package before the session: 
- Include the immutable export hash (SHA256) visible in kv-cache-timestamps.csv and a short note describing the hashing process.
- If possible, include the KMS audit entry id as a separate line in ops-witness-checklist.pdf so the auditors can cross-reference.

We will forward this to our SOC 2 auditor and SIG lead; they may drop a quick question in advance but nothing major anticipated. Looking forward to the session.

Elena
